overview.label: BRAND OVERVIEW
overview.title: The entire sound journey, designed as a single value chain.
overview.p1: Great music experiences don't end at production. AUDIOGUY precisely captures the essence of sound through recording, mixing, and mastering, and expands it into immersive listening experiences with Sound 360's spatial-sound technology.
overview.p2: And the completed sound is connected to market- and platform-specific distribution through SEORO. AUDIOGUY designs production, spatial audio, and distribution not as separate stages but as a single flow.
overview.p3: We don't stop at making sound.
overview.p4: We design how music sounds, how the experience expands, and which markets it reaches. AUDIOGUY is an audio value-chain group that turns music into more immersive experiences.

tech.title: Verified Technology
tech.subtitle: Spatial Audio AI Engine
tech.name: AI-SPHR
tech.description: AI-SPHR is AUDIOGUY’s proprietary engine that analyzes audio sources, converts them into spatial audio structures, and reviews the output against global platform standards.
tech.card1Desc: Trained a spatial-audio conversion model on 6,000+ high-quality audio datasets.
tech.card2Desc: Analyzes a track’s frequencies, instrument placement, and reverb characteristics to design a three-dimensional sound structure.
tech.card3Desc: Converts the result to meet the standards of global platforms such as Dolby Atmos and Apple Music.

Our goal is to bring free, immersive sound experiences to popular music. Through 3D spatial sound that delivers stunning presence and sounds designed by audio professionals, discover every sonic experience you can imagine.
